tip: FIX — When the homeowner said "I want a replacement back just in case it happens again, because I ran into this on the other unit," that opened the door to address his recurrence fear. The tech should have asked "What happened with the other unit—how long was it down?" to uncover the real pain point, then presented a maintenance-focused option that prevents it. Instead, "Let me figure out what's going on first" missed the moment to reconnect and build value.
